title: Cozy Cole's drummers band
summary: He heard of a heavy-percussion band and doubts Cozy's style fit.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: What about -- I'm interested in that period, the late '40s and early '50s. I read somewhere that Cozy Cole started a band that didn't last long with something like seven drummers in the front line, was a very heavy percussion group.
Yeah, I hear about it, and I never get
to see it. He invite me a couple times for rehearsals, something like that. He was doing something by Gene Krupa.

This was -- yeah, this was -- this was -- I don't know whether they were Cuban or Puerto Rican or what, but I think they had two or three congas. They made about four recordings (inaudible). AND THEN THEY DISAPPEARED.
I tell you what they -- I don't think Cozy would -- with his way playing -- would never fit this kind of rhythms.
